# Mediabunny 1.59.0

Unmodified `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the published `mediabunny@1.59.0` npm package, self-hosted for local video frame-timestamp reading. Licensed under MPL-2.0; see LICENSE. Corresponding source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.59.0 and https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.59.0.tgz (includes src/).

No media leaves the browser. Only the worker imports this bundle; it uses container metadata, not decoding or network sources.
